resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1933 for the L-4 cab at $650; the 1932 clippings show construction starting in late September 1932 with a cost of about $650. The story reports 1933 as the register's date and notes the clippings' earlier start.
NHLR gives 7,991 ft (2,436 m); firelookout.com gives 8090 ft. Not used in the story; noted for the editor.

notes_for_editor: Build history conflicts: NHLR says a camp in 1928 then the L-4 in 1933, while a 1931 clipping says a smoke chaser occupied the Bear Top lookout before the 1932 house. Name variants: Beartop, Bear Top, Bare Top, Bare mountain. No source found for current staffing, rental or visiting status; the register's 'usually staffed' line is undated. The FFLA Facebook post did not load. The Hiking Project trail is not confirmed as the route to the lookout. Pages read: 5 (firelookout, montanalookouts, NHLR, FS cabin page, Hiking Project).
